title: All-on-X vs Dentures: Complete Guide for Valencia Patients
seoTitle: All-on-X vs Dentures: Which Full-Arch Option Fits You
seoDescription: Compare All-on-X and dentures on stability, bone health, upkeep and long-term value. Then bring the consult checklist to our Valencia office.
excerpt: Fixed full-arch implants or removable dentures? See how they compare on chewing, bone preservation, maintenance and lifetime cost before you decide.
keyTakeaways: All-on-X is fixed to four to six implants and helps slow jawbone loss; dentures rest on the gums and do not.
Dentures cost less up front but need relines and replacement; implant bridges may need renewal after 10 to 20 years.
Smoking and uncontrolled diabetes raise implant complication risk; most clinicians advise quitting through healing.
Bring a CBCT scan and ask for an itemized estimate that lists surgery, parts, lab work and any grafts.
Peri-implantitis is a real long-term risk, so implants need lifelong hygiene and regular checks.
imageAlt: Models of a full-arch implant bridge and a removable denture side by side
flags: Uses the phrase 'permanent-feeling teeth'; 'permanent' is a banned word in the copy guide.
Unsourced statistics: All-on-X 'restores 70-90% of natural bite' and dentures deliver '10-40% of natural' chewing force.
FAQ 'Will All-on-X stop bone loss?' answers 'Yes'; implants slow resorption but do not stop it (the body text says 'slow').
Plain-text CTA 'Schedule a Free Implant Evaluation' with no link; a free evaluation offer is not an approved offer.
Price ranges are attributed to 'our own local practice pricing estimates'; the copy guide forbids practice-specific prices.
Internal link /services/oral-surgery/all-on-4-implants/ does not match the current site routes (nav uses /services/dental-implants/).
Reddit threads (adhesive products, smoking after All-on-4) are used as evidence.
